title: mini_ai
summary: A student notebook project for a Mini AI course at VU Amsterdam that trains and compares several tabular synthetic-data generators (CTGAN, CopulaGAN, GaussianCopula, TVAE, PAR) on a dataset and evaluates them with statistical and quality metrics. It runs SDV's single-table and sequential synthesizers and sdmetrics evaluation utilities directly via the sdv and sdmetrics Python APIs.
needs: No dataset domain or author names given; course project for VU Amsterdam Mini AI Project, capped importance per tutorial rule.
